create_llm_openai: create an OpenAI LLM instance from a config dict with type, model, and api_key
create_llm_claude: create a Claude LLM instance from a config dict with type, model, and api_key
create_llm_gemini: create a Gemini LLM instance from a config dict with type, model, and api_key
create_llm_huggingface: create a HuggingFace LLM instance from a config dict with model name and device settings
load_config_yaml: load LLM configuration from a YAML file at the default or specified path
